definitions.explanation: The act of repeating or copying words from another source.

⟦{出典|しゅってん}→出典：06424_shutten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明記|めいき}して→明記：13030_meiki⟧{引用|いんよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To cite with the source clearly noted.

notes:
{引用|いんよう} refers to the act of quoting or citing text from another source, as well as the quoted passage itself. Used primarily in academic, journalistic, and legal contexts.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引用|いんよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMPOUNDS:
- {引用|いんよう}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧: quoted text, quotation
- {引用|いんよう}⟦{符|ふ}→符：noentry⟧/{引用|いんよう}⟦{符号|ふごう}→符号：00042_fugou⟧: quotation marks
- {引用|いんよう}⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧: citation source
- {引用|いんよう}⟦{文献|ぶんけん}→文献：12885_bunken⟧: cited references, bibliography

USAGE:
{引用|いんよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to quote or cite. In Japanese academic writing, proper {引用|いんよう} requires noting the ⟦{出典|しゅってん}→出典：06424_shutten⟧ (source). Quoting without attribution is considered ⟦{盗用|とうよう}→盗用：23322_touyou⟧ (plagiarism).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引用|いんよう}: directly quoting someone's words
- ⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧: reference, consulting (not direct quoting)
- ⟦{転載|てんさい}→転載：14359_tensai⟧: reprinting, reproducing content
